name: NHN Corporation
summary: NHN Corporation, an IT company, provides gaming, payment, entertainment, IT, and advertisement solutions in South Korea and internationally. It offers PAYCO, a payment service for online and offline stores; comico, a Webtoon platform; Bugs, a music portal operating music streaming and online music distribution business; and NHN KCP, an integrated e-payment service.
